newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Sweden's TV4 sees uncertain ad market.
newsitem.headline: Sweden's TV4 sees uncertain ad market.

text.p: Sweden's TV advertising market looks uncertain for the rest of 1996 with the market slipping 1.9 percent in the first half of the year but climbing 13 percent in the third quarter, commercial TV station TV4 said on Monday.
TV4 said its advertising revenue rose 1.3 percent in the first nine months of 1996.
"The full year forecast is, however, still uncertain with zero growth or a weak reduction," it said in a statement.
For the nine months, TV4 made a loss after financial items of 40.4 million crowns compared with a profit of 136.6 million crowns in the corresponding period a year ago.
Income slipped to 1.12 billion crowns from 1.15 billion crowns.
Advertising income dipped to 1.04 billion crowns in the first nine months against 1.05 billion a year earlier.
TV4's share of Sweden's television market in the third quarter was 66.5 percent compared to 68.6 percent a year ago, and against 66.2 percent for the full year 1995.
TV4's total number of viewers rose 4.7 percent in the nine months from a year ago.
